analysis:
The supplied units are head-side excerpts of CHANGELOG.md, lines 3454-3958. The patch adds a v0.10.7 candidate section above them (head lines 11-413). The excerpts cover older, mostly historical changelog entries that were pushed down by the insertion. They contain no executable code, configuration, key handling, authorization logic or wire-format changes, so no security control in this PR can be shown to change here.

Relevant statements checked against the threat model:
- Line 3456 describes enabling the encrypted SSD prefix cache by default for three Bonsai 2 identities. It says the global cache opt-out, fresh load hashes and runtime identity gates are preserved. This is consistent with T-041. The DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE kill switch, the 30-minute TTL and the HMAC-keyed names are unchanged by the text. Any real code change would need SEC-035 review, but this PR only shows documentation of it.
- Lines 3467 and 3473-3494 describe App Attest serving and MDM-optional authorization. They say serving and removal stay disabled by default and that signed-artifact qualification is retained, and they describe fencing on expiry and revocation. These match TB-011, T-052, T-053, T-054 and T-057. The changelog prose cannot show the implementation, and no contradiction with the threat model is visible.
- Line 3456 also says that signed persistent-restart qualification and coordinator artifact allowlisting remain separate rollout steps. That is consistent with the documented gating.

The patch excerpt is truncated at the upgrade note about pair-wise tensor-parallel and cluster behavior. The remaining v0.10.7 section (head lines 11-413) is not in the supplied units, so any claim there that the threat model needs updating, such as new cluster or pair-serving trust boundaries, is unverified here. Whether the actual code behind these changelog claims matches them was not supplied. Because the visible text is documentation-only, no regression is asserted, and the cluster and tensor-parallel material is flagged for review if its code appears in another batch.
